housing.summary: Numbeo's July 2026 Wollongong data reports AUD 1,430 per month for a one-bedroom city-centre apartment; NSW caps a rental bond at four weeks' rent, represented as one month here; realestate.com.au is Australia's leading property resource and provides a Wollongong rental search.

banking.summary: Newcomer options supported by official bank pages include CommBank and ANZ Plus. ANZ Plus requires a passport, selfie, Australian mobile number and Australian residential address; CommBank's arrival setup requires its welcome letter, the first two pages of the Visa Grant notice, the original current passport and foreign tax-residency TINs.
required_docs: Selfie for ANZ Plus identity verification
CommBank welcome letter and first two pages of Visa Grant notice when finishing CommBank setup
Tax Identification Number for each foreign country of tax residence when finishing CommBank setup
banks_named: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group (ANZ Plus)

schools.summary: The Illawarra Grammar School in the Wollongong region offers invitation-only Cambridge IGCSE Co-ordinated Sciences and Global Perspectives; the NSW Public School Finder is the official directory for local and nearby public schools.

legal_admin.summary: Most passengers entering Australia must complete and present an Incoming Passenger Card, including their intended Australian address; the responsible authority is the Australian Border Force.
legal_admin.registration_step: Complete and present the Incoming Passenger Card on arrival, including the intended address in Australia.

tax_finance.summary: A permanent migrant or temporary visitor who is in Australia and holds a valid work-rights visa can apply free online for a Tax File Number through the Australian Taxation Office's Individual Auto-Registration system.

transport.summary: Wollongong is in the Illawarra Opal network. No monthly pass is published; adult pay-as-you-go travel is capped at AUD 50 per week. Australian citizens, permanent residents and New Zealand licence holders must transfer an overseas licence within three months; temporary overseas visitors arriving after 1 July 2023 may use an overseas licence for up to six months. Eligible permanent residents can enrol in Medicare online through myGov or with a Medicare enrolment form.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Australian citizens, permanent residents and New Zealand licence holders may drive on an overseas licence for three months and must transfer it within that period; temporary overseas visitors arriving after 1 July 2023 may drive on an overseas licence for up to six months, then must apply for a temporary NSW licence to continue driving.
transport.healthcare_registration: Eligible permanent residents living in Australia can enrol in Medicare online through myGov using a current passport or ImmiCard and valid Home Affairs visa details, or submit a Medicare enrolment form with supporting documents.
